about: Types (version 6): a name given a colour twice, names that are no names, colours that are not #rrggbb, a stop that changes to a type with a space at the end, and a change of type at the last stop.
problems: type "rapid": another type has the same name
type " local": the name must not be empty, start or end with a space, or contain a control character
type "local": the color must be # and six hexadecimal digits, such as #d9822b
types[4]: the name must not be empty, start or end with a space, or contain a control character
types[4]: the color must be # and six hexadecimal digits, such as #d9822b
train "1", stop 2 "S": the type must not start or end with a space or contain a control character
train "1", stop 3 "B": is the last stop, which the train does not leave, so it changes no type
